title: How fast would a GTA car need to go to reach space?

lines.say: GTA 6 drops this week. So how fast would your car need to go to drive into orbit?
A really fast sports car tops out around three hundred kilometres an hour.
To stay in orbit, you'd need twenty-eight thousand. That's over ninety times faster!
And at that speed, the air would heat your car until it burned up.
